photos.llama_desc: A group of three children, two girls and one boy, stand in front of a large, round, interactive screen. The screen features a cartoon-like image of a snail with wings, a rainbow, and a question: "What goes on top?" The children are standing on a yellow and blue platform, with a yellow rail in front of them. The boy is wearing a red and grey jacket, while the girls are wearing a blue and a white and grey hoodie.
photos.oracle_desc: Three children — two girls and one boy — stand with their backs to the camera, engaged with a large circular interactive display mounted inside a porthole-style frame. The colorful screen shows a cartoon snail, a rainbow, and a fill-in-the-blank question. A yellow safety railing runs along the front of the exhibit platform.

photos.llama_desc: A group of children in variously colored soccer jerseys and shorts running across a grassy field. A pink ball is in the foreground, and a few adults are standing on the field, some of them holding soccer balls. A few people are standing on the far side of the field, and a few trees are in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: Young children in colorful soccer jerseys run across a wide grassy field during a practice or game. A pink ball and an orange traffic cone sit in the immediate foreground. Adult coaches or parents are visible at the far end of the field, with a tree line along the horizon under a partly cloudy blue sky.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a red top and khaki pants stands next to a table with a white tablecloth, surrounded by numerous gifts and gift bags. The woman has long dark hair and is wearing a red top with a V-neck and a pair of khaki pants. The table is covered with a white tablecloth and is covered in a variety of gifts and gift bags, including several large gift boxes, several gift bags, and several smaller gifts.
photos.oracle_desc: A visibly pregnant woman in a pink-red top and khaki pants stands beside a white-clothed table overflowing with wrapped gifts, large gift boxes, and colorful gift bags. The setting and abundance of baby-themed wrapping suggest a baby shower. Additional gift bags are arranged on the floor around the table.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a black shirt with a white logo on her left chest, surrounded by three children, one boy and two girls, all with long hair, smiling and hugging her. The woman is sitting at a table with a white tablecloth, with a white plate in front of her with a lit birthday cake with a single candle. The children are standing behind her, with their arms around her.
photos.oracle_desc: Four children crowd around a smiling woman seated at a dining table, leaning in to embrace her for a birthday photo. A small cake slice with a single lit candle sits on the plate in front of her. Three girls and one boy are grouped around her, all grinning at the camera.

photos.llama_desc: A group of children in front of a yellow school bus. They are wearing paper crowns and have paper flowers in their hair. They are standing on a concrete road.
photos.oracle_desc: Two young girls stand in the foreground in front of a yellow school bus, each wearing a handmade paper crown or leaf headband. The girl in front wears a pink-accented white top and pink skirt, while the girl behind her is dressed in a tan outfit. Other children and adults are partially visible on either side in the background.

photos.llama_desc: A group of five children, all wearing bunny ears, stand in front of a green metal railing. The children are dressed in Easter-themed outfits, with the girls wearing pink and yellow plaid dresses and the boys wearing pink and orange shirts. The girls are holding small Easter-themed bags and one of the girls is holding a baby.
photos.oracle_desc: Five children wearing white bunny-ear headbands pose together indoors in front of flowering spring display arrangements, likely inside a mall. Three girls wear matching orange-and-cream plaid dresses, while one boy in a salmon shirt holds a smiling infant. A green railing is partially visible behind them.

photos.llama_desc: A plate of food on a wooden table. A sandwich is cut in half and served on a checkered paper plate, with a few chips and a pair of sunglasses on the side. The table is in a dimly lit, casual restaurant or bar, with a few people sitting at a table in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: A hot dog or sausage sandwich served in a checkered paper-lined basket alongside a pile of chips rests on a wooden table in a dimly lit bar or casual restaurant. A pair of sunglasses sits to the left of the basket. Several patrons are seated and partially visible in the softly blurred background.

photos.llama_desc: A group of children and adults in a bowling alley. They are standing in a line, smiling and looking at the camera. The children are wearing casual, casual- to- dressy clothing, and some of them are wearing shoes.
photos.oracle_desc: Six girls stand together in two informal rows on a bowling alley lane, smiling at the camera. They are dressed in casual summer clothing — shorts, t-shirts, and tank tops. The distinctive yellow lane bumpers and bowling alley decor are visible behind them.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a red and white Detroit Red Wings jersey holding the Stanley Cup. She is standing on a white platform, holding the trophy above her head with both hands, her arms and the cup's top end of the handle visible. The woman's hair is long and blonde, and she is wearing a red and white scarf around her neck.
photos.oracle_desc: A girl poses with her face inserted through a Detroit Red Wings player cardboard cutout, making it appear she is lifting the Stanley Cup overhead with both arms. The life-size standee depicts the full Red Wings uniform and the iconic trophy against a dark background. No scarf is present; the jersey and body belong to the printed cutout.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a red tartan dress and a purple "Happy Birthday" headband sits at a table with a chocolate birthday cake with lit candles. The cake has a large "3" candle and several smaller ones. The girl is wearing a red tartan dress with a black turtleneck underneath.
photos.oracle_desc: A young girl in a red-and-black tartan dress and a sparkly purple tiara sits at a wooden table in front of a round chocolate birthday cake topped with multiple lit colored candles. Stuffed animals and decorative needlepoint pillows are visible on the window seat behind her. She is smiling brightly at the camera.
